name: Coarse-grained LES dry convective boundary layer simulation suite
model_or_instrument: Large Eddy Simulation code (Albertson 1996; Bou-Zeid et al. 2005; Kumar et al. 2006)
size_as_stated: 600k samples across 6 simulations, 5 scalars, and 20k samples each
resolution: Original LES: 256^3 cubic domain, dx=dy=24 m, dz=6 m; coarse-grained horizontally to 1.5 km (4x4 grids) and 128 vertical levels

scales.note: LES domain 256x24 m = 6144 m; coarse-grained by factor of 64 to 1536 m (4x4 grids); 1250 1-minute snapshots per simulation yielding 20,000 column samples.
